items.title: Ball Corporation Reports 24% Revenue Growth to $4.19 Billion as Packaging Volumes Rise
items.summary: Ball Corporation (NYSE:BALL) reported third-quarter earnings and revenue above Wall Street expectations on Tuesday, supported by higher global aluminum packaging shipments and increased sales across its regional operations. The company also reaffirmed its 2026 outlook for double-digit comparable earnings growth and substantial free cash flow generation.

items.title: Ball (NYSE:BALL) surprises with strong Q3 2026
items.summary: Packaging manufacturer Ball (NYSE:BALL) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 23.9% year on year to $4.19 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.10 per share was 2.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
